title: Madonna and Child with Saints and Angels
creator: Spinello Aretino
description: The Madonna with child surrounded by Saints Helena, Anthony, John and an unidentified female saint. Two angels with instruments also appear and kneel in the foreground. The Madonna wears a semi-transparent veil, red top, and blue mantle with gold trim. Christ wears a gold colored gown and holds red flowers in the fold of his dressing at his left side.

title: Judgment of Paris
creator: Paolo Veronese
description: Image of Paris, shadowed at the right, Hera and Aphrodite, all standing, with Pallas Athene perched to the far left on a small, natural form. Pallas Athene's arms are open and she holds a fruit (an apple?) in her right hand. Three angels are above Aphrodite and a light-colored dog rests, curled at the bottom right corner. The figures are in a sparsely wooded area, with a open sky and a mountain in the background.

title: Madonna and Child
creator: Giovanni di Lorenzo Larciani
description: The Madonna wears a blue mantle that covers a pinkish red top and a muted blue-green bottom. While the Madonna looks outward toward the viewer, Christ reaches and looks up toward his mother. The background shows a two-story dwelling to the left, a hill with structures at the right, and greenery and small figures throughout
subject: Paintings; Oil; Panel; Madonna; Christ; Sixteenth Century

title: Madonna and Child with St. Stephen and St. Lawrence
creator: Giovanni di Ser Giovanni Gui
description: The Madonna with child seated between Saints Stephen and Lawrence. The Madonna wears a thin, white veil, red gown, and blue mantle with gold trim and is seated in a greenish colored throne. Christ stands in his mother's lap, wrapped around the torso with a thin fabric, which he holds away from his body with his right hand. St. Stephen, standing to the left of the throne, holds a quill in his right hand and the end of the fabric held out by Christ in his right hand. St. Lawrence stands to the right of the throne and folds his hands in prayer. Both saints are dressed in a similar manner: reddish, full-length robes with gold and black trim.
subject: Paintings; Tempera; Gilding; Panel; Madonna; Christ; Saints

title: Annunciation
creator: Giovanni del Biondo
description: Gabriel appearing before the Virgin - Gabriel, dressed in a red mantle, kneels and extends his right arm while blessing the Virgin. His yellow wings are open. The Virgin stands with her arms crossed opposite Gabriel. She is dressed in a white fur-lined blue mantle and crimson dress. At her feet rests an open book on a red pillow. Between the two is the Dove of the Holy Spirit. Figures stand before a gold columned portico.
subject: Paintings; Tempera; Panel; Gilding; Annunciation; Angel; Bible Story
